title: Quick Bouncy Korean Basil Bao
description: This pungent and festive Korean-inspired dish is perfect for a quick snack or meal. Featuring Thai holy basil, steamed mushrooms, and a touch of Korean spices, this recipe is both jain-friendly and easy on the palate.
instructions: Steam mushrooms in a steamer basket over boiling water for 4 minutes.
In a small pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add 1/4 cup of chopped Thai holy basil and cook for 30 seconds, until wilted.
